_comment: FIXTURE CONFIG - read only by serve.test.mjs, format.test.mjs and
installation/check's render leg, never by a real run. Named config.fixture.json
and not config.json because a config.json anywhere in a skill directory is an
install's SPECIFIC file, which the fleet's layout gate refuses.
Every value here is synthetic. 'transcripts.config_dir' is a placeholder that
is never used: the test copies fixtures/config-dir/ into a temporary
<tmp>/<agent>/.claude and passes it as CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, which wins over this
key - so the test measures the same precedence a real run has.
'identities' is absent on purpose: absent means the roster shipped beside
format.mjs, which is the default every install starts from.
'fleet.by_config_dir' is keyed 'fixture-agent' because the test copies the
tree to <tmp>/fixture-agent/.claude, whose BASENAME is '.claude'. That is the
case fleetKey() exists for, and it is the case under test: keyed by basename
the label would not resolve at all here.
